classifications.rationale: Agency heads must establish and publicize an internal employee-appeals system; this is executive administrative organization rather than a presently imposed legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: shall establish within the department or agency a system for the reconsideration of administrative decisions

classifications.rationale: Departments and agencies receive discretionary authority to design internal appeals procedures suited to their organizational needs.
classifications.evidence: each department and agency is authorized to develop such agency appeals procedures

classifications.rationale: The Commission is directed to issue implementing regulations, without this segment dictating a particular legally consequential regulatory result.
classifications.evidence: shall, not later than April 1, 1962, issue regulations to put this order into effect

classifications.rationale: The Commission must conduct an ongoing implementation review, which is an internal oversight function.
classifications.evidence: shall make a continuing review of the manner in which this order is being implemented

classifications.rationale: The segment itself establishes binding procedural entitlements for affected employees, including a hearing, representation, protection against reprisal, and official time; agencies later administer those rights.
classifications.evidence: The employee shall have the right to be accompanied, represented, and advised by a representative of his own choosing

classifications.rationale: This segment inseparably combines discretionary internal-management authority with self-executing exclusions of named agencies and an effective-date rule governing covered adverse actions.
classifications.evidence: This order shall not apply to the Central Intelligence Agency, the National Security Agency, the Federal Bureau of Investigation, the Atomic Energy Commission, and the Tennessee Valley Authority.
